questions.question: At a solid white stop line on a quiet rural lane, what must you do?
options: Stop completely behind the line even if clear
Only stop if traffic is coming
questions.explanation: Rule 171 says you must stop completely behind every solid white stop line.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a sharp rural bend?
options: Slow down before the bend and keep left
Cross the centre line to straighten the corner
questions.explanation: Rule 125 says slow down for bends so you can stop in view.

questions.question: How many driving faults can you have and still pass a UK practical test?
options: Up to 15 driving faults with no serious or dangerous faults
questions.explanation: The practical driving test allows at most 15 driving faults and 0 fails.
